title: Refactor Contributor Identification to Alias
description: Contributors are no longer identified by their GitHub name but with their alias from contributor.json. Refactor all code, data, test to use alias-based IDs (e.g. 🧑‍💻ueli instead of 🧑‍💻httpsgithubcomusalu or 🧑‍💻usalu). Update Go CLI contributor loading, ID generation, conversion functions, all JSON data files, and all tests.
